title: Great experience.
text: All the people were super sweet and over achieved. The only thing I would recommend is to make clear that with 2 people you get only 1 time of driving in the car. I expected it to be 2x20 minutes as you are buying it for 2 people.
author: Maurice_H

title: Not Quite a Yacht, but Great Tour!
text:
The drive was excellent! The driver who rides with you,  Humberto, was also excellent! I believe the car was a 2016, so it wasn't very old. I enjoyed every minute of it. 

A couple of things to note: 

- They no longer have access to the brick and mortar address they provide for you to meet them. We thought for a minute we got scammed until we saw the driver arrive. 

-The tour operators are easy to reach by phone and communicate very well. They were very helpful. 

-The yacht is actually a boat. We were expecting something larger. It was still a great experience and the captain was really goo
author: albH4535EH

title: Loved the drive in the Ferrari, the...
text:
Loved the drive in the Ferrari, the instructor was very friendly and laid back. He also allowed him to put his foot down a few times! Only criticism is that I would have liked to have known where to meet earlier for planning purposes.
Boat trip was also fantastic, we even got to steer!
author: Emma H
